meta.title: Article Metadata
meta.description: Joomla with the guided tour "Article Metadata".

steps.title: Metadata Matters
steps.text: Metadata tells search engines and browsers what a page is about.

steps.sql:
UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Article Metadata', 'joomlaguide-article-metadata', '

Metadata is information about a page in its HTML, inside the <head> tag: visitors do not see it, but search engines and browsers read it.

The playground already has a featured article Metadata Matters. In this tour you change its title and give it a description, robots instructions and an author, and you see each of them appear in the page source.

This tour follows the tutorial 12.1 Article Metadata of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_content"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 12.1 Article Metadata', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-metadata'), 'Look at the page source', '

Click this button with your site\'s name: your site opens in a new tab (in the Joomla Playground you can also click Site in its toolbar).

Click the title Metadata Matters to open the article, then view the page source (in most browsers: right-click the page and choose View Page Source, or press Ctrl+U).

Near the top, inside <head>, the tag <title> holds the title of the article: Joomla sets it for you.

Keep that tab open, come back to this tab and click Next.

', 1, 'bottom', '#header a.header-item-content[target="_blank"]', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-metadata'), 'Content', '

In the menu on the left, click Content.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 2, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-metadata'), 'Content › Articles', '

Click Articles in Content.

', 3, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-metadata'), 'Open the article', '

Click Metadata Matters.

', 4, 'right', '.view-articles #articleList a[title="Edit Metadata Matters"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-metadata'), 'Change the title', '

Add a word to the title, for example:

Why Metadata Matters

Then click Next.

', 5, 'bottom', '.view-article #jform_title', 2, 2, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-metadata'), 'Save', '

Click Save.

Joomla saves the article and keeps it open.

', 6, 'bottom', '.view-article #toolbar-apply .button-apply', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-metadata'), 'The title changed', '

Go to the tab with the page source and reload it: the <title> tag shows the new title.

Come back to this tab and click Next.

', 7, 'bottom', '#header a.header-item-content[target="_blank"]', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-metadata'), 'Publishing', '

The other metadata of an article is on the tab Publishing, in the box Metadata. Click the tab Publishing.

', 8, 'bottom', '.view-article button[aria-controls="publishing"]', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-metadata'), 'Meta Description', '

Type a short description of the article, for example:

What metadata is and why search engines need it.

Search engines often show it below the title in their results. Then click Next.

', 9, 'left', '.view-article #jform_metadesc', 2, 2, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-metadata'), 'Robots', '

Choose index, follow.

This tells search engines to index this page and to follow its links.

', 10, 'left', '.view-article #jform_metadata_robots', 2, 6, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1,"requiredvalue":"index, follow"}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-metadata'), 'Author', '

Type the name of the author, for example:

Jane Doe

Then click Next.

', 11, 'left', '.view-article #jform_metadata_author', 2, 2, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-metadata'), 'Save the article', '

Click Save & Close.

', 12, 'bottom', '.view-article #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-article-metadata'), 'Well done!', '

Go to the tab with the page source and reload it. Inside <head> you now find:

  • <meta name="description" ...> with your description
  • <meta name="robots" content="index, follow">
  • <meta name="author" ...> with the author

There is more metadata on the web, such as Open Graph data for social media and schemas that describe a person, place or product.

', 13, 'bottom', '#header a.header-item-content[target="_blank"]', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL);
